template.description: Supported Enterprise CADPlan Lite templates. Use blank_part only for an empty/new part with no geometry features.

part_name.description: Safe part name only; no paths or file extensions.

base.description: Main plate body. Rectangular plates use length, width, and thickness. Circular bases use diameter plus thickness; validator mirrors diameter into length and width.

shape.description: Base shape. Use rectangle unless the user explicitly requests a circular base.

length.description: Rectangular base length in mm. Use explicit user-provided dimensions before fallback defaults. Use fallback 120 only when length is omitted.

width.description: Rectangular base width in mm. Use explicit user-provided dimensions before fallback defaults. Use fallback 80 only when width is omitted.

thickness.description: Base thickness in mm. Use explicit user-provided dimensions before fallback defaults. Use fallback 12 only when thickness is omitted.

corner_holes.description: Standard four-corner through-hole pattern for screws, bolts, mounting holes, or clearance holes on a rectangular plate.

enabled.description: True when the user requests four corner holes.

diameter.description: Hole diameter in mm as a JSON number. M6 clearance holes must be 6.6, not the string M6. If four-corner holes are requested but the user omits diameter, recommend a value from context; otherwise use fallback 6.6 and note it.

offset_x.description: Hole center X offset from the plate center in mm. Omit when the user does not specify edge margin or offset.

offset_y.description: Hole center Y offset from the plate center in mm. Omit when the user does not specify edge margin or offset.

center_boss.description: One centered circular raised boss/platform/cylindrical pad on top of the base. Map centered round raised platforms here.

enabled.description: True when the user requests a center boss, raised round platform, or cylindrical pad.

diameter.description: Boss/platform diameter in mm. If a boss is requested but diameter is omitted, recommend a value from context; otherwise use fallback 30 and note it.

height.description: Boss/platform height in mm. If a boss is requested but height is omitted, recommend a value from context; otherwise use fallback 25 and note it.

center_hole.description: One through hole at the center of the center boss/platform or, when no boss is requested, at the center of the base top face.

enabled.description: True when the user requests a center hole through the boss/platform.

diameter.description: Center hole diameter in mm. If a center hole is requested but diameter is omitted, recommend a value from context. Keep it smaller than center_boss.diameter when a boss exists, otherwise smaller than the base width/diameter.

target.description: Validator-filled target. LLM may omit it.

fillet.description: Rounded base outer edges. Map edge rounding, outside contour rounding, smoothing, deburring, and edge-break intent here.

enabled.description: True when the user requests rounded/smoothed outside edges or an explicit R radius.

radius.description: Fillet radius in mm. If rounding is requested without a radius, recommend a value from context; otherwise use fallback 2 and note it.

outputs.description: Optional output switches. Never include paths or output directories.

notes.description: Short notes for defaulted or inferred values that need user confirmation.

unsupported.description: True only when the request cannot be represented by CADPlan Lite.

errors.description: Short unsupported-reason messages when unsupported is true.
